events.title: Flea market at the Naschmarkt
events.description: Vienna's classic Saturday flea market with second-hand goods, curiosities and rarities.

events.title: Classic Cool! Baby concert: Sound Magic
events.description: A relaxed 40-minute concert for parents and babies, pairing piano music with Monet's water lilies.

events.title: Army show at Heldenplatz (Leistungsschau Kompakt)
events.description: The Austrian Armed Forces' compact show ahead of National Day, at Heldenplatz and the Burgtheater. Large bags and backpacks aren't allowed.

events.title: Alles Kreide! Open chalk studio
events.description: Drop-in studio where families draw with pastels and pavement chalk; entry on the hour, last entry 15:30. Wear old clothes.

events.title: Baby and kids' flea market in Floridsdorf
events.description: Second-hand baby and children's clothes, toys and family equipment.

events.title: Koko und der weiße Vogel (puppet theatre)
events.description: A little bear sets off to find a flower for his sleeping friend in this puppet play, in German. Second show at 16:30.

events.title: Archikids: building with fungi and clay
events.description: A hands-on workshop where kids find out how fungi can become eco-friendly building material, mostly working with clay. Register by email to anmeldung@azw.at.

events.title: DAS MONSTERPROJEKT (theatre, music and dance)
events.description: Performers turn the stage into a studio and invent monsters and mythical creatures with theatre, music and dance. 60 minutes, in German.

events.title: Classic Cool! Sun, Moon and Stars
events.description: An interactive concert retelling the legend of St. Martin with piano and violin; kids can try the instruments afterwards.

events.title: Aschenputtel (marionette fairy tale)
events.description: Cinderella told with marionettes, narration and music, about 45 minutes. Reserve by email or phone.

events.title: Giant flea market at Wienerberg
events.description: A large Sunday-morning flea market in the open air.

events.title: MetaMarkt indoor flea market
events.description: A big weatherproof flea market inside a hall.

events.title: Theatre and language workshops for kids
events.description: Sunday workshops combining theatre play and language development for young children.

events.title: Wiener Sicherheitsfest at Rathausplatz
events.description: The city's free safety festival: hands-on stations by the fire brigade, police and rescue services, police and rescue dog demos, emergency vehicles, a fire-ladder ride, bouncy castles and a kids' show (Robert Steiner and Rolf Rüdiger). No registration needed.

events.title: Army show at Heldenplatz (Leistungsschau Kompakt)
events.description: The Austrian Armed Forces' compact show ahead of National Day, at Heldenplatz and the Burgtheater. Concert by the Gardemusik at 13:00. Large bags and backpacks aren't allowed.

events.title: Koko und der weiße Vogel (puppet theatre)
events.description: A little bear sets off to find a flower for his sleeping friend in this puppet play, in German. Second show at 16:30.

events.title: Planetarium: Mission Weltall 2 – Sun, Moon & Stars
events.description: A kids' show under the planetarium dome. Check the planetarium's programme for tickets.

events.title: DAS MONSTERPROJEKT (theatre, music and dance)
events.description: Performers turn the stage into a studio and invent monsters and mythical creatures with theatre, music and dance. 60 minutes, in German. Followed by a theatre workshop for kids 8+ at 16:30.

events.title: Bernhard Fibich: Sunshine and Rain (sing-along concert)
events.description: An interactive kids' concert where songwriter Bernhard Fibich gets children and adults singing and dancing along.

events.title: Planetarium: Die Sternenmachmaschine
events.description: A kids' show under the planetarium dome. Check the planetarium's programme for tickets.
